top_signals.title: Gold Slumps to Lowest in a Year on Inflation, Tech-Stock Rout
top_signals.summary: Gold tumbled to the lowest in a year as rising oil prices added to inflationary pressures while traders sold the precious metal to cover losses elsewhere amid a global tech-stock rout.

top_signals.title: Chile Copper Mines Deliver Worst Quarter in at Least Two Decades
top_signals.summary: Chile’s copper output slumped to its lowest quarterly level in at least two decades as accidents and wild weather compounded operational setbacks and the effects of deteriorating ore quality in the top-producing nation.
